description: Ministry of Sports - Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, Order under Section 32 and 33 of the sports Law, Suspend the Registration of Sri Lanka Cricket from 05.11.2023
reasoning: This gazette contains both the name of a specific government official (Roshan Ranasinghe, Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs) and detailed descriptions of the powers, functions, and duties being exercised. It includes the suspension of Sri Lanka Cricket's registration, the appointment of an Interim Committee with specific members named, and detailed responsibilities assigned to the committee including conducting inquiries, exercising powers of Sri Lanka Cricket, and making strategic recommendations. This combination of named individuals and detailed portfolio responsibilities qualifies it as a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
